newsitem.title: ITALY: RALLYING-WORLD CHAMPION MAKINEN CRASHES IN SAN REMO RALLY.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-WORLD CHAMPION MAKINEN CRASHES IN SAN REMO RALLY.

text.p: Tommi Makinen, newly-crowned world champion, crashed on the first stage of the San Remo Rally on Monday and his injured co-driver was flown to hospital.
The Finn rolled his Mitsubishi heavily just 500 metres into the rally and went out of the race.
Makinen, who said he had misjudged a corner, was unhurt but co-driver Seppo Harjanne injured his back and was taken by helicopter to hospital where he was detained for an x-ray.
The first stage was cancelled after another Finn, Jarmo Kytolehto, crashed his Ford within sight of the start.
Italy's Andrea Dallavilla took the race lead in his Toyota after setting the fastest time in the second test.
"It was a big surprise to me because I have a problem with the brakes and I drove 17 kilometres with a puncture," Dallavilla, leading a world championship rally for the first time, said.
Dallavilla led by three seconds from compatriot Gilberto Pianezzola, who also drives for Toyota.
The San Remo Rally is the eighth round of the world championship.
